arabic_text: اللّهُمَّ إن تَشَأْ تعفُ عَنّا فَبِفضْلِكَ ، وَانْ تَشَأْ تُعَذِّبْنا فَبَعدْلِكَ. فَسَهِّلْ لَنَا عَفْوَكَ بِمنِّكَ ، وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ عَذَابِكَ بِتَجاوُزكَ; فَإنَّهُ لاَ طاقَةَ لَنَا بَعدلِكَ، وَلاَ نجاةَ لأحَد مِنّا دُوْنَ عَفْوِكَ.
transliteration: allāhumma in tashaʾ taʿfu ʿannā fabifadlika wa in tasha'a tu'azzibna fa badluka. fasahhil lana 'afwaka bimannika wa-ajirna min ʿadhabika bi-tajawuzika, fa-innahu la taqata lana baʿdaka wa lā najāta li-aḥadin minnā dūna ʿafwikā
english_text: O God, if Thou willest, Thou wilt pardon us through Thy bounty and if Thou willest, Thou wilt chastise us through Thy justice. So make our ways smooth to Thy pardon through Thy kindness and grant us sanctuary from Thy chastisement through Thy forbearance, for none of us has the endurance for Thy justice and none of us can reach deliverance without Thy pardon!

arabic_text: يا غَنِيَّ الأغْنياء هَا نَحَنُ عِبادُكَ بين يدَيكَ
transliteration: yā ġanīyy al-aġniyāʾ, hā nahanu ʿibāduka bayna yadayka
english_text: O Richest of the rich! Here we are, Thy servants, before Thee.

arabic_text: وَأَنَا أَفقَرُ الفْقَراء إليْكَ فَأجْبُرْ فاقَتَنا بِوُسْعِكَ ، ولا تَقْطَعَ رَجَاءنا بِمَنْعِكَ فَتَكُوْنَ قد أَشْقَيْتَ مَنِ اسْتَسْعَدَ بِكَ ، وَجَرَمْتَ مَنِ اسْتَرْفَدَ فَضْلَكَ.
transliteration: wa-ana afqaru al-fuqarāʾ ilayka fa-ajbur faqatanā bi-wusʿika wa lā taqṭaʿ rajāʾanā bi-manʿik, fatakoona qad ashqayta mani istasʿada bika wa-ja-ram-ta mani as-tar-fa-da fa-dlaka
english_text: I am the neediest of the needy toward Thee, so redress our neediness through Thy plenty and cut us not off from our hopes through Thy withholding, lest Thou makest wretched him who seeks felicity through Thee and deprivest him who seeks help from Thy bounty!
Then to whom would we return after Thee?
Where would we go from Thy gate?

arabic_text: سُبْحَنَكَ نَحْنُ المضْطُّرون الذّينَ أَوْجَبْتَ إجابَتَهُمْ ، وَأهْلُ السُّوْء الذّيْنَ وَعَدْتَ الْكَشْفَ عَنْهُمْ.
transliteration: subḥānaka naḥnu al-muḍḍaṭṭūn alladhīna awjabta ijābatuhum wa-ahlus-sū'u alladhīna waʿadtal-kashfa ʿanhum
english_text: Glory be to Thee! We are the distressed, the response to whom Thou hast made incumbent, the people from whom Thou hast promised to remove the evil.

arabic_text: وَأَشْبَـهُ الأَشْياءِ بِمَشِيَّتِـكَ ، وَأَوْلَى الأمُورِ بِكَ فِيْ عَظَمَتِكَ رَحْمَةُ مَنِ اسْتَرْحَمَكَ، وَغَوْثُ مَنِ اسْتَغَاثَ بِكَ، فَارْحَمْ تَضَرُّعَنَا إلَيْكَ، وَأَغْنِنَا إذْ طَرَحْنَـا أَنْفُسَنَا بَيْنَ يَـدَيْكَ.
transliteration: wa ashbahul-ashya'i bimashiyyatika wa-awla al-amoori bika fee `adamatika rahmatu mani istarhamaka wa-ghawthu mani-staghatha bika, farham tadarruna ilayk waʾaghninā ʾidh ṭarahnā ʾanfusanā bayna yadayk
english_text: That thing most resembling Thy will and that affair most worthy for Thee in Thy mightiness is showing mercy to him who asks Thee for mercy and helping him who seeks help from Thee. So show mercy upon our pleading with Thee and free us from need when we throw ourselves before Thee!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ شمِتَ بِنَا إذْ شَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى مَعْصِيَتِكَ، فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَلا تُشْمِتْهُ بِنَا بَعْدَ تَرْكِنَا إيَّاهُ لَكَ، وَرَغْبَتِنَا عَنْهُ إلَيْكَ.
transliteration: allāhumma innash shayṭāna qad shamat binā idh shāyʿanāhu ʿalā maʿṣiyatika faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih walā tušmit-hu binā baʿda tarik-nā 'iyyā-hu lak wa raghbatina anhu ilayka
english_text: O God, Satan will gloat over us if we follow him in disobeying Thee, so bless Muhammad and his Household and let him not gloat over us after we have renounced him for Thee and beseeched Thee against him!
